analysis.audience: Inferred from the supplied material; confirm if material to the edit.
assumptions: Timing is estimated at approximately 150 words per minute.

global_style.typography: bold condensed display face for hooks, neutral sans-serif for supporting labels
global_style.texture: subtle paper grain with restrained halftone accents
global_style.recurring_motif: a thin coral route line that becomes a reveal mask

scenes.treatment_reason: the opening hook needs immediate emphasis and a readable reveal

direction.asset_strategy: deterministic graphics first; optional local assets validated before use

scenes.visual_concept: Make the idea 'Ideas become visible.' tangible using kinetic typography
scenes.composition: one dominant focal subject in the lower third, with supporting labels in a quiet margin
scenes.animation: reveal the focal subject, introduce one supporting element, then resolve into a clear graphic match
scenes.camera: a restrained push-in with a lateral parallax shift
scenes.transition: match the final shape or direction into the next scene
scenes.on_screen_text: Use only a short keyword or exact supplied number; typeset precise copy in post.
scenes.sound: a soft paper movement on the reveal and a restrained tonal accent on the hold
scenes.continuity: Keep the global palette, coral route-line motif, and camera direction.
scenes.prompt: Create a 9:16 editorial explainer scene in kinetic typography style. Global palette: #0B1020, #F4EBDD, #F15A4A, #28B8A6, #F4C95D. Show Make the idea 'Ideas become visible.' tangible using kinetic typography with one dominant focal subject in the lower third, with supporting labels in a quiet margin. Animate in this order: reveal the focal subject, introduce one supporting element, then resolve into a clear graphic match. Use a restrained push-in with a lateral parallax shift camera movement. Start with the described quiet setup and end on the focal reveal that leads into the next scene. Maintain the shared a thin coral route line that becomes a reveal mask motif and subtle paper grain with restrained halftone accents texture. Use clean shapes and controlled contrast. No logos, watermarks, unrelated objects, malformed typography, invented numbers, visual clutter, or style drift. If exact text or data is required, leave a clean overlay area for post-production.
